data.description: Authors every asset by hand, runs the checks, and releases every plugin at one version.

data.label: jsdotnet-devbook marketplace
data.description: The Claude Code plugin marketplace of agents, skills, rules, and hooks that drive delivery work.

data.label: devbook
data.description: Addressed Markdown chapters, their meta block, the check, and the reconcile that puts the convention into a repository.

data.label: Chapter
data.description: One addressable heading with its meta block and anchored annotations, the block's consistency boundary.

data.label: Meta Block
data.description: The flat block under a heading that turns it into a graph node.

data.label: Annotation
data.description: A review note fenced inside a chapter and deleted when it is resolved.

data.label: Devbook Folder
data.description: One of the governed folders under .devbook and the unit of adoption.

data.label: Change
data.description: A proposed change folder whose deltas merge into the chapters it lands in.

data.label: Demo
data.description: A self-contained HTML page showing what a person sees in a bounded context.

data.label: C4 Model
data.description: The Structurizr DSL workspace of an arc42 folder and the reader that checks it.

data.label: Reference Graph
data.description: The derived graph of every chapter as a node and every reference as an edge.

data.label: Reconciler
data.description: Brings a repository level with the installed release and stamps what it materialized.

data.label: Index Generator
data.description: The checker that walks the corpus and builds the graph, the outline, and the registers.

data.label: Fence Writer
data.description: The only writer of annotation fences, as a command and as functions.

data.label: Tech Inventory
data.description: Scripts that read package manifests and emit deterministic JSON.

data.label: Scenario Tools
data.description: The runner, reporter, signature, coverage check, and demo sync that tie end-to-end specs to scenario pages.

data.label: Unit Lister
data.description: Lists every sync unit and group with its effective sync direction.

data.label: Spec Converter
data.description: The capture, apply, and verify skills, one service between a chapter and its code.

data.label: Procedure
data.description: One of the five repository-owned skills run, capture, diagnose, estimate, and prototype.

data.label: Goal
data.description: The one sentence a procedure must satisfy, rendered into its wrappers.

data.label: Demo Template
data.description: The starting HTML template with a managed region every demo is built on.

data.label: delivery
data.description: The delivery engine: one unit of work carried from request to review-ready change inside one session.

data.label: Run
data.description: One execution of one flow over one unit of work, with its stages, gate decisions, and outcome.

data.label: Flow
data.description: A staged procedure named for what it changes, running a fixed phase order in one session.

data.label: Stack Config
data.description: The engine-owned keys of the repository's config: bindings, phases, policy, gates, and areas.

data.label: Flow Runner
data.description: The agent that sequences a flow's phases, resolves each phase entry, tracks the run, and holds every gate.

data.label: Phase
data.description: The unit a repository configures: one stable id, one phase skill, and one entry per flow.

data.label: Gate
data.description: A human checkpoint on a phase that a person answers with approve, revise, or decline.

data.label: Pull Request Lane
data.description: Pushes, updates, fixes the checks of, and scores a finished pull request until it is merge-ready.

data.label: devbook-config
data.description: What this stack is, what this machine has, and how this repository is wired.

data.label: Stack Report
data.description: Reads what is on disk and gives every fact with the source it came from.

data.label: Engine Configuration
data.description: The engine keys this block alone writes into the stack config.

data.label: Init Service
data.description: Writes a repository's engine keys the first time, then runs each component's own init.

data.label: Update Service
data.description: Moves the configured stack forward by running each adopted component's own update.

data.label: Ask Service
data.description: Answers questions about the marketplace from what is on disk, writing nothing.

data.label: Adoption Drift
data.description: Reports where the ai/ adoption record has drifted from what is installed and wired.

data.label: devbook-skills
data.description: Reusable guidance any plugin names and none depends on.

data.label: Show-me Catalog
data.description: Pairs each kind of content with the picture that shows it.

data.label: Research Brief
data.description: A question answered from primary sources, each claim cited with its confidence.

data.label: PR Body
data.description: A pull request description in Summary, Evidence, and Merge Danger.

data.label: Retro Lenses
data.description: Ten lenses, each pairing what to look for with the change it calls for.

data.label: Wayfinder Map
data.description: An effort too big for one session planned as a map of decision tickets.

data.label: devbook-derived
data.description: The committed _meta/ index, its refresh paths, the rendered C4 views, and the graph canvas.

data.label: Refresh Paths
data.description: The skill, script, and workflows that rewrite the committed _meta/ indexes.

data.label: View Renderer
data.description: Draws every C4 view of the workspace as a committed SVG.

data.label: Canvas
data.description: Two Copilot canvases drawing the reference graph and one chapter live.

data.label: devbook-collaboration
data.description: How a chapter is reviewed and decided: findings in the chapter, and an approval that stays valid.

data.label: Review Position
data.description: One chapter's place in a review, read from its rung and its open fences and never stored.

data.label: Finding
data.description: One unresolved objection, kept as an annotation fence in the chapter body.

data.label: Approval
data.description: Writes the approved rung and its record and sweeps the resolved notes.

data.label: Review Queue
data.description: Reports open notes, pending decisions, and stale approvals across every adopted folder.

data.label: Acceptance
data.description: Writes the accepted rung and its record on top of an approval.

data.label: devbook-openspec
data.description: The change lane: OpenSpec installed and configured so a change is a set of deltas against the chapters.

data.label: Schema
data.description: The project schema defining a change's artifacts from proposal through deltas to tasks.

data.label: Config
data.description: The seeded OpenSpec config with context, per-artifact rules, and apply and archive routing.

data.label: Change Rule
data.description: The host rule that keeps OpenSpec's skills to devbook's change shape inside a change folder.

data.label: Step State
data.description: Works out each step's state from the ticked tasks file, never from a branch.

data.label: Landing a Change
data.description: Checks the gates, merges the deltas, and has OpenSpec move the change.

data.label: Stamp
data.description: Records the plugin version, the CLI range, and the materialized files.

data.label: delivery-schedule
data.description: Work that runs with nobody watching, and the catalog of triggers that fires it.

data.label: Schedule
data.description: One trigger pairing a cadence, a target, the plugins it needs, and a self-contained prompt.

data.label: Schedule Selection
data.description: The schedules a repository chose and the cadence overrides it set.

data.label: Scheduler Resolution
data.description: Finds the host's scheduler in the live session and creates, updates, disables, reads, or fires entries through it.

data.label: Catalog Check
data.description: Rejects a malformed catalog entry, a cadence above hourly, a flow target, and an unnamed placeholder.

data.label: Entry Point
data.description: A schedule-* skill that picks its own input and runs unattended without passing a gate.

data.label: delivery-surface-dashboard
data.description: The live view of a run, measured by hooks rather than told.

data.label: Run Record
data.description: One run with its stages, prompts, evidence, gate decisions, telemetry, and handoff marker, kept per worktree.

data.label: Viewer
data.description: The run timeline, diagram viewer, and document viewer pages, inline or on a loopback origin.

data.label: Report Export
data.description: Writes the run's report from the recorded data as Markdown or self-contained HTML.

data.label: Telemetry Capture
data.description: A hook on the host's tool events folding tool calls, sub-agents, and tokens into the run record.

data.label: delivery-surface-collector
data.description: A run recorded to disk rather than watched, for unattended sessions.

data.label: Run Record
data.description: One unattended run kept on disk with stages, gate decisions, evidence paths, and a handoff marker.

data.label: Report Export
data.description: Writes the run's report from the recorded data, in Markdown only.

data.label: delivery-surface-backlog
data.description: A run shown in the Backlog desktop app, where its work item already lives.

data.label: Proxy Server
data.description: The stdio server that forwards lifecycle and export calls to the endpoint inside the running Backlog app.

data.label: Endpoint
data.description: The Backlog address and bearer token, from the environment, then settings, then the default port.

data.label: Declared Tools
data.description: The tool names this server lists and forwards, export only while Backlog lists it.

data.label: delivery-surface-canvas
data.description: Mermaid and Markdown rendered live beside the files they came from, on one host and with no marketplace entry.

data.label: View
data.description: The diagram or document a canvas shows, with its breadcrumb history and nothing persisted.

data.label: Canvas Transport
data.description: Registers the two canvases, serves their pages on a loopback port with a token, and pushes view changes.

data.label: delivery-run-view
data.description: A run drawn inside Claude Code from the files the surfaces write; not a surface.

data.label: Register Module
data.description: Polls the run files, infers what they leave out, and draws the pane, band, rows, status line, and gate alerts.

data.label: State Contract
data.description: The type declarations of the state the module keeps.

data.label: Gate Sound
data.description: The clip played when a run reaches a gate or blocks.

data.label: devbook-config-view
data.description: Every repository on this machine, its stamps against the newest and its phase maps, drawn inside Claude Code.

data.label: Register Module
data.description: Finds the repositories, reads their configs, and draws the rollout pane.

data.label: State Contract
data.description: The type contract of the rollout state the module keeps.

data.label: Claude Code
data.description: The authoring host that loads manifests, skills, agents, hooks, and MCP servers, and runs scheduled routines.

data.label: GitHub Copilot
data.description: The second host, loading the same manifest, skill, and hook files and its own extensions.

data.label: A consuming repository
data.description: A repository that installs a component and keeps its stamp in .devbook/config.json.

data.label: GitHub
data.description: Runs the checks on every pull request, refreshes the index on a schedule, and is the tracker a flow reports to.

data.label: Scheduled local routine
data.description: Starts a session in a fresh worktree of a repository on the maintainer's machine, with nobody watching.

data.label: Backlog desktop app
data.description: Holds the work items, reads the committed _meta/ index off disk, and answers as a surface.

data.label: context
data.description: The marketplace, the person who authors it, the two hosts that load it, and the systems its plugins reach.

data.label: plugins
data.description: The fourteen plugins grouped by layer, every arrow in the direction of the coupling.

data.description: The register module, its state, and its sound.
